title: TEOS Standard
description: Machine-readable contract for a versioned external or internal body of technical-education requirements. A Standard preserves authority and provenance without owning curriculum delivery or institutional scheduling.

standard_id.description: Stable TEOS identity unique within the Standard namespace.

version.description: The TEOS version of this Standard contract.

official_identifier.description: The identifier assigned by the issuing organization, when one exists.

official_version.description: The official edition or version assigned by the issuer, distinct from the TEOS object version.

issuer.description: The issuing organization or internal governing owner.

title.description: The official or approved title of the Standard.

description.description: A TEOS-maintained description that does not replace official requirement text.

source.description: The authoritative publication, repository, or controlled internal source.

requirements_scope.description: The body or subset of requirements represented by this object.

publication_date.description: The publication date of the represented official Standard.

effective_context.description: The jurisdiction, program, or other context in which the Standard is effective.

source_uri.description: A resolvable URI for the authoritative Standard source.

competency_references.description: Version-bound Competencies governed or informed by the Standard.

revision.description: An issuer or maintainer revision label that is distinct from semantic compatibility versioning.

owner.description: The TEOS owner when different from the issuer.

maintainer.description: The organization responsible for maintaining this TEOS representation.

revision_notes.description: A non-empty explanation of changes in this version.

lifecycle_status.description: The shared lifecycle state of the Standard.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative authorship, revision, and provenance metadata.
